findings.title: The new SDF_LZ4 branch takes over the return of the UE_IO branch, so IoStore jobs fall through.
findings.body:
In `scan_file_in`, the two new lines go between `ue_io_shaders(path, rel, args[2][1], found)` and the 8-space `return rel, uniq_keys(found), …` context line. That return used to end the UE_IO branch. After this patch it sits under the new `if … == SDF_LZ4:` block, so the UE_IO branch no longer returns.

Every IoStore job from `ue_legacy_jobs` now runs on into the FB_CAS check and the rest of the function, including the loose scan of the container. Its shaders may then be duplicated or mis-keyed, or the job may fail. This affects games that already worked before this patch. It looks like a bad merge from the rebase onto the pin's IoStore reader, and the PR says the split was not rerun after the rebase.

Fix: keep the existing `return` as a context line right after `ue_io_shaders(...)`. Then add the SDF_LZ4 branch after it with its own `return rel, uniq_keys(found), var_pairs(found), trees`, and update the hunk header and diffstat counts to match.
